fixture_notice: DEV FIXTURE — not an observation and not a forecast. Generated for parallel UI work.

northern_sea_route.definition: Proxy, not a route solver. A month is open when the mean concentration of unmasked cells in lat 66–80 N, lon 30–180 E is below 15%. Days = 30 per open month, 28 in February. opening_date is the first day of the first open month on or after June, else null when no month from June onward is open.

northwest_passage.definition: Same proxy for lat 68–75 N, lon 140 W–60 W.

definitions.ice_free_september_year: First year in 1979–2100 whose September northern extent_km2 is below 1000000 under this scenario's median band. null if none.
definitions.winter_ice_loss_index: Share of unmasked cells at lat >= 60 N whose 1981–2010 February mean was >= 15% and whose February concentration in the selected year is < 15%. Range 0–1. null if that climatology cannot be built.

sea_level.baseline: Mass anomaly relative to the first GRACE sample, converted as mm = -mass_gt / 362. total_mm = greenland_mm + antarctica_mm. low_mm and high_mm are totals.
